event_text: Airbyte's status page opens an incident for data syncs failing or delayed
Airbyte says users now see HTTP 502 errors in its web app and API and ties them to the incident
Airbyte says it found a security incident it believes is part of a broader, global cyberattack, and took Cloud offline
notes: 21:09 UTC on the status page; trackers cite its X post at about 21:01 UTC.

event_text: Airbyte begins 'gradually returning services' to Cloud, starting with backend syncs for some customers
Airbyte says most data syncs and database connectors work; API sources, Connector Builder and MCP are unavailable
Airbyte says Airbyte Cloud is back online, with Connector Builder and MCP offline until further notice
notes: Time of day not shown on the mirror we read.

event_text: Salesforce posts an advisory that it disabled the Airbyte connected app after suspicious activity
Airbyte lists 16 API connectors still down because OAuth is deactivated
Airbyte says Intercom OAuth is fixed; 15 API connectors, Connector Builder and MCP stay down
notes: 06:00 UTC. Latest update on the page when we checked.
